notes.subject: strongpela bel
notes.rationale: שרירות em i strongpela/stubbornness bilong bel — 'bel i hat' o 'strongpela bel', bel = לב

notes.subject: ילכו ... במועצותיהם
notes.rationale: Wokabaut long tingting bilong ol yet — pasin Israel i no bihainim Yahwe, nem bilong psalm long 81:13

translation: Na mi salim ⟨את⟩ ol ⟨i⟩ go long strongpela bel bilong ol yet, na ol i wokabaut long ol tingting bilong ol yet.
